title: X-Men Legends
statusNote: Plays: N-Gage, Activision, Marvel and Barking Lizards logos, title screen, main menu, Single-Player > New Game plays the intro video and loads the first street level; after the opening dialogue the team of four can be walked around and attacks, and the map, objectives, stats and pause menus open.
notes: The logos at the start cannot be skipped and take about half a minute. The title screen then waits for any key.
Key 5 skips the intro video and steps through dialogue; OK does not.
The left soft key opens the pause menu (Resume, Load, Save, Options, Stats, Quit). The right soft key closes the map, the objectives and the stats screen.

A Bluetooth game is under Multiplayer on the main menu: one player chooses Host Game, the other Join Game and then the host in the list. The host sees the other player under "Accept players", chooses Start game and then New Game, and the story starts for both, each with their own hero of the team.

multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room: one hosts, the other joins and picks the host, the host chooses Start game and New Game; the first level ran on both screens, one player as Wolverine and the other as Cyclops, each seeing the other walk. One player's pause shows "Paused" to the other, and the host's game goes on when the other quits. More than two players and a saved game were not tried.

controls.source: The game's own Options > Controller screen (its default keys for the nine actions). Moving, attacking, the map, objectives, the stats menu, both soft keys and 5 for dialogue and the video were also tried in play.

actions.5: Attack; next line of dialogue; skip the video
